Class LuaScriptService

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.lua.LuaScriptService
public final class LuaScriptService extends Object
Stores MeshApp Lua scripts and their isolated key-value data.

Encapsulates the application database tables for source code, launch state, runtime errors, and key-value entries owned by individual scripts.
